subject: Initial PO assignment & line-item sweep for HarvestPay vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <procure@harvestpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: HarvestPay vendor onboarding + PO request

Hi Monica,

Attached the completed onboarding packet and SKU list for initial activation. We are planning the first shipment week of Aug 16 — can you confirm provisional PO numbers and an initial spend cap? Our internal target for month 1 is $60,000 but happy to stage.

Attachments: harvestpay_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor onboarding form), harvestpay_sku_list.xlsx (SKU price/qty export)

Quick summary:
- Company: HarvestPay (Tax ID: 98-7654321) — details in attached form
- Initial SKU bundle: 12 SKUs, 3 lines flagged as special pricing (see SKU sheet)
- Requested month-1 spend cap: $60,000

Let me know what you need from our side to get a PO issued.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Lead, HarvestPay
liam@harvestpay.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <procure@harvestpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HarvestPay vendor onboarding + PO request

Thanks Liam — welcome aboard. I got the form and SKU export. A few quick items before we issue a provisional PO: 

1) Procurement needs vendor remit and bank details (W-9 and remit) — please attach bank remit instructions if not in the PDF.
2) We normally provision a conservative initial spend cap while FS does a quick credit check; I'll request $50k provisional and ask finance to greenlight $60k if they confirm numbers.
3) In the SKU sheet I see a unit-price/quantity mismatch on row 3 (unit price looks like line total). Can you re-upload a corrected CSV for line-item parity? That speeds automated PO creation.

If you can get the corrected CSV + remit info by end of day tomorrow (Aug 4), I can start the provisional PO flow and share a DocuSign/Procure tracker link.

Attaching: onboarding checklist (internal) — noted items we still need.

Subject: Re: HarvestPay vendor onboarding + PO request

Looping finance in briefly — I ran the onboarding info through a quick credit/counterparty check. We can approve the $60k month-1 cap, subject to corrected line-item pricing and standard net-45 payment terms.

Concrete asks for HarvestPay: 
- Confirm that "Row 3" on the SKU export is a unit price, not a line total. If it's a line total, we need corrected unit_price column and quantity integer.
- Provide bank remit (routing + account) in a separate PDF. For security, send to olga_petrov@redwood.com and I will route to FS.

Once that corrected CSV + remit are in, I'll clear the $60k spend cap and Monica can issue a provisional PO number for the initial shipment.

Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
